# Automatically Generated Views

This directory contains views automatically generated by the ResourceController based on the Controller configuration.

**DO NOT EDIT THESE FILES DIRECTLY.**
Any changes made here will be overwritten when the cache is cleared or regenerated.

## How to Customize

To customize a view (e.g., `list.blade.php`):
1. Copy the file from this directory.
2. Paste it into the custom directory:
   `/var/www/html/public/templates/custom/Banks/BankAccount`
3. Edit the copied file.

The system automatically prioritizes the file in the custom directory.
